title: Protocol Canary upstream version matrix (matrixVersion 1)
description: Which upstream component releases belong to each Stellar protocol version. A component's `range` is a set of space-separated semver comparators that a release must satisfy to be the software for that protocol; the major version of every upstream component tracks the protocol version.
$comment: Validated with tools/validate/jsonschema_lite.py, which implements only the keywords used here. `protocols` requires the sections for the protocols this repository documents (28 and 29); adding a protocol means adding its section to upstream-matrix.json and to `required` below in the same change. The protocol keys are strings because JSON object keys are.

source.description: The page the versions were read from.

checkedOn.description: The date `source` was read, as YYYY-MM-DD.

semverRange.description: One or more space-separated comparators (`>=`, `<=`, `>`, `<`, `=` or none) each followed by MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with no leading zeros and no `v` prefix, for example `>=28.0.0 <29.0.0`.

repository.description: The upstream GitHub repository as owner/name.
